events.title: Term 3 opening day
events.body: All students report to school by 5:00pm.

events.title: Inter-house sports day
events.body: Held on the school grounds. Parents welcome from 9:00am.

events.title: Mid-term examinations begin
events.body: Runs for one week across all forms.

events.title: Parents' Day — Form 2 & Form 3
events.body: Parents and guardians meet subject teachers to review progress.

events.title: Alumni Homecoming Day
events.body: Old girls return to campus — organised with the alumni association.

events.title: Prize-giving day
events.body: Recognising top academic and co-curricular achievers this term.

events.title: Term 3 closing day
events.body: School closes for the December holidays.
